about_the_game:
A faint light pulls you from the depths. Drawn by its flicker, you journey to the edge of the world—only to find it in ruins. All that greets you is the distant echo of an ancient voice.

What are they trying to tell you?

Light Odyssey is a high-speed boss rush action game where you take on massive colossi in a world born of light, shadow, and cosmic mystery. Play as Bandi, a being of fading light, and fight for survival as you uncover the truth behind a lost civilization.

Clash with Giants

Face off against colossal enemies that tower dozens of times over you. Each one has its own powers, patterns, and weaknesses—and they won’t hold back.

With striking visuals that blend light and darkness, tight parry-based combat, and deep customization, every battle is a thrilling test of skill. Mix and match weapons, abilities, and character sigils to craft your perfect strategy.

Evolving Battles, Endless Challenge

No two fights are the same. As battles progress, stages collapse, environments shift, and unexpected twists—like high-speed chases or hidden mechanics—emerge. Adapt on the fly, master enemy patterns, and reshape your tactics to survive ever-changing encounters.

A World Full of Secrets

Explore a haunting, silent world shrouded in mist. Decode ancient languages, restore forgotten machines, and uncover the fate of those who came before. Every step brings you closer to the truth—and deeper into the unknown.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 550 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 750 or higher
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
